title: Fix Auto Hide Cursor recovery and Crosshairs auto-hide

review.body_prefix:
Reviewed the cursor-recovery state transitions and transparent-monochrome visibility path. Timer-observed movement still passes through `OnMouseInput` and its intentional-movement check before showing a hidden pointer. Failure to obtain the position requests restoration rather than hiding blindly. The crosshairs helper validates the mask format and exact bitmap-read byte count and returns an unknown result on API failure.

The examined paths do not establish another required correction. The two-pixel threshold governs restoration of an already hidden pointer; it does not mean every sub-threshold physical input must be ignored for idle accounting. The UI helper explicitly tests the replaced system arrow rather than arbitrary currently active cursor types.

This is a qualified source assessment, not an independently executed native-product/UI sign-off. The author's VM and worker-test evidence remains attributed to the author; secure-desktop, hook interference, loaded-runner timing and physical cursor recovery have not been independently exercised here.

**Current discussion reassessment:** Additional suggestions about initial-position bookkeeping, shared-header placement, and bitmap scanning do not establish a new failing production or test scenario. The arrow-observation contract remains intentional. No independently executed secure-desktop or physical-cursor result is added by this reassessment.
